days.title: Towns and Valleys of the South
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Ritterkapelle
stops.detail: But for the market square and the Ritterkapelle, rising more than 17 metres high, we barely spare them a glance at the moment.

stops.name: Abt-Degen-Weintal Valley
stops.detail: Abt-Degen-Weintal Valley: below flows the River Main, above it is gravel biker sweat

stops.name: Zeil am Main
stops.detail: We only unclip again when we roll into the half-timbered town of Zeil am Main and marvel at the coexistence of beer and wine.

stops.name: Zeiler Käppele
stops.detail: We head through them – uff, why is there no e-gravel bike? – steeply uphill to the pilgrimage church of Zeiler Käppele.

stops.name: Gutshof Andres
stops.detail: This is also the case on the way to Gutshof Andres, where Bernd Andres has earned a Michelin mention for his cooking, with fish as his speciality.

stops.name: Königsberg
stops.detail: To get there, we speed along the Rennweg until we reach one of the few connecting roads and then hurtle downhill towards Königsberg at speeds of over 60 kilometres per hour.
